scoring_justification: The checker recomputes eq_radius_um using the same modified Kelvin equation and thermodynamic data, comparing against the agent's radii with 5% relative tolerance per row.

outputs.description: Equilibrium radii computed by solving the modified Kelvin equation. The checker will recompute eq_radius_um from the same input data and compare against the agent's values using a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The checker independently solves the same equations with the same provided data to compute gold radii; it scores by comparing the agent's eq_radius_um against these recomputed values.

steps.notes: Recompute eq_radius_um for every (dry_radius_um, rh_pct) pair with 5% relative tolerance. Score = fraction of pairs within tolerance.
